# PROMPT 01
# VALIDATION INFRASTRUCTURE

Version: 1.0

Status: Mandatory

Priority: CRITICAL

Depends On:

01A-reference-atlas.md

---

# PURPOSE

Create the validation pipeline that will be used for every future sprite family.

The pipeline must prevent:

- identity drift
- missing frames
- incomplete animation sets
- broken integrations

No sprite set may be integrated without passing this pipeline.

---

# ART REFERENCE

Mandatory reference:

official-character.png

Character Art Bible

Global Art Rules

Reference Atlas

---

# PIPELINE COMPONENTS

Create:

scripts/character-state-validator.js

scripts/character-state-review.js

tests/character-state-viewer.html

---

# CHARACTER STATE VALIDATOR

Purpose:

Structural validation.

Not artistic validation.

---

# VALIDATIONS

Validate:

## File Existence

Every expected frame exists.

---

## Frame Count

Frame count matches expected count.

---

## Resolution

Frame dimensions valid.

---

## Alpha

Alpha channel valid.

---

## Empty Frame Detection

Reject:

fully empty frames.

---

## Transparent Frame Detection

Reject:

100% transparent frames.

---

## Corrupt Frame Detection

Reject:

invalid image data.

---

## Bounding Box Detection

Generate bounding box report.

---

## Anchor Validation

Validate anchor positions.

---

# OUTPUT

Generate:

validator-report.json

validator-report.md

---

# PASS CONDITIONS

All expected frames exist.

No corrupt frames.

No missing frames.

No dimension mismatches.

---

# FAILURE CONDITIONS

Any missing frame.

Any corrupt frame.

Any invalid alpha.

Any invalid dimensions.

---

# CHARACTER STATE REVIEW

Purpose:

Artistic and animation validation.

---

# FEATURES

Generate:

heatmaps

comparison sheets

loop GIFs

transition GIFs

review reports

---

# HEATMAPS

Compare:

official frame

versus

new frame

---

Color scheme:

Green = unchanged

Red = changed

---

Generate:

heatmaps/

for every frame reviewed.

---

# IDENTITY REVIEW

Evaluate:

hair

face

silhouette

palette

rendering

age

---

# CONTACT REVIEW

For carry:

Does object touch hands?

Does object float?

Does object intersect head?

Does object intersect face?

Does object intersect dress?

---

# SWORD REVIEW

For sword:

Does sword touch hands?

Does sword float?

Does sword intersect body?

Does sword intersect face?

---

# ATTACK REVIEW

For attack:

Disable:

- trail
- particles
- glow
- sound

Question:

Does the animation still communicate an attack?

---

# LOOP VALIDATION

Generate GIF:

run cycle

carry cycle

sword cycle

attack sequence

---

Review:

teleportation

jitter

contact loss

position jumps

---

# 500MS TEST

Generate automatic comparison:

run

↓

carry

↓

run

↓

carry

↓

run

---

Question:

Same character?

Or different character?

---

Repeat for:

run

↓

sword

↓

run

↓

sword

↓

run

---

# HTML REVIEWER

Create:

tests/character-state-viewer.html

---

Capabilities:

Load JSON state definitions.

Display animation.

Display frame metadata.

Display heatmaps.

Display comparisons.

Display GIF previews.

---

# REVIEW REPORT

Generate:

review-report.md

Must contain:

identity results

contact results

animation results

review verdict

---

# FEW SHOT 01

CORRECT

Complete run cycle.

↓

Complete carry cycle.

↓

Character remains identical.

PASS.

---

# FEW SHOT 02

INCORRECT

Carry cycle.

↓

Different face.

↓

Different rendering.

FAIL.

---

# FEW SHOT 03

INCORRECT

Object clips through face.

FAIL.

---

# FEW SHOT 04

INCORRECT

Only one carry frame exists.

FAIL.

---

# FEW SHOT 05

CORRECT

Full animation family exists.

Identity unchanged.

PASS.

---

# AUTOMATION

Expected pipeline:

Generate sprites

↓

Validator

↓

PASS

↓

Review

↓

PASS

↓

Build

↓

Tests

↓

Integration

---

# BLOCKING RULE

No state family may continue if:

Validator = FAIL

or

Review = FAIL

---

# APPROVAL

Prompt approved when:

validator exists

review system exists

viewer exists

reports generated

official atlas passes validation

---

# END GOAL

Future production must become repeatable.

Review decisions must rely on evidence.

Not memory.

Not opinions.

Not assumptions.
